answer: Each identity locks 70 credits on the reef. Each epoch a lottery draws one in ten; each drawn identity must whisper a work receipt to the ledge, the audit board. Auditors replay receipts: a stale, copied, or missing one burns the bond. Filing 38 first, then 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented whisper fails: its signatures mismatch the borrower, burning both bonds. Honest agents pay 38 once.
